q: In Micah, from which small town would Israel's ruler come?
quote: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel

q: In Micah, what does the LORD require: act justly, love mercy, and what?
why: God has shown what is good.
quote: to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your God?

q: In Micah, where will God cast all our sins?
a: Into the depths of the sea
quote: You will cast out all our sins into the depths of the sea.

q: In Micah's vision of peace, what will nations beat their swords into?
why: They will train for war no more.
quote: Then they will beat their swords into plowshares

q: In Micah, how old are the origins of the ruler from Bethlehem?
quote: One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.

q: In Micah, what does God delight in?
why: He does not stay angry forever.
quote: who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?

q: In Micah, the prophet asks, “Who is a God like You, who pardons…”
quote: Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity

q: In Micah's vision, what will nations turn their spears into?
quote: and their spears into pruning hooks.

q: In Micah, what town was the prophet Micah from?
quote: This is the word of the LORD that came to Micah the Moreshite

q: In Micah, what other name is given to Bethlehem?
why: It was small among Judah's clans.
